props.title: Frequently Asked Questions
props.subtitle: Dive into the following questions to gain insights into the powerful features that AstroWind offers and how it can elevate your web development journey.

items.title: Why AstroWind?
items.description: Because it gives you a production-ready starting point instead of a blank page: sensible defaults, real components and a structure that scales past the demo.

items.title: What do I need to start?
items.description: Node and a package manager. Clone the template, install dependencies, and you have a running site in under a minute.

items.title: How do I install the Astro + Tailwind CSS template?
items.description: Fork the repository or use it as a template on GitHub, then run the install command for your package manager of choice.

items.title: Can I use it for a commercial project?
items.description: Yes. The template is MIT licensed, so you can use it for personal and commercial work alike.

items.title: How do I customize the design?
items.description: Colors, fonts and spacing come from design tokens. Change the tokens and every component follows — no need to touch individual widgets.

items.title: Where do I get help?
items.description: Open an issue or a discussion on GitHub. The community is active and the documentation lives in this very blog.
